name: 7 Days
description: 7 Days is a New Zealand comedy gameshow similar in some ways to the British program Mock the Week, hosted by Jeremy Corbett and created by The Down Low Concept. Paul Ego and Dai Henwood usually appear on each episode, along with other comedians, who form teams and answer questions about news stories from the last week.

videos.overview: An hour long "year in review" episode covering events over the past 12 months. The show features Paul Ego with Jeremy Elwood and Ben Hurley against Dai Henwood with and Michele A’Court and Steve Wrigley.
